# Repository instructions

## GitHub release notes

Whenever creating, refreshing, drafting, or publishing a GitHub release:

- Write or update the release body before considering the release task complete.
- Summarize the user-visible changes and important fixes in clear language, including the root cause when it helps users understand a corrected failure.
- State the relevant validation performed, such as builds, tests, packaging checks, or deployment verification.
- List or describe the release assets when installers or other downloadable artifacts are attached.
- Keep a full-changelog comparison link when useful, but never leave the release notes as only autogenerated commit text or a comparison link.
- After creating or editing the release, verify the live body, draft/published state, and assets with `gh release view`, then report the release URL.
